description.p: A native GNOME interface for reading, writing, creating, and browsing floppy disk images, with offline browsing for AmigaDOS, FAT12, Acorn DFS/ADFS, Commodore 1541, Color Disk BASIC, and OS-9 filesystems, automatic browsing of HFE and raw-flux containers, preservation reports, image inspection and conversion, zipped source images, HxC HFE track-image support, and Greaseweazle drive tools.

ul.li: Open, inspect, compare, and write disk images supplied inside a zip file. A zip holding several images asks which one to use, and the zip is never modified.
Catalogue the disk images inside zip files in the Image Library, including duplicates of loose images.
Update the bundled urllib3 library to 2.8.0.
Add Check for Application Updates to the About window. It downloads the package for the installed system, verifies it against the release checksums, installs it, and offers a restart.
Add an Updating Greaseweazle-GUI topic to the user guide.
Update the bundled bitarray library to 3.11.0.
Browse Acorn ADFS S, M, and L images, including HFE containers.
Add Tandy Color Disk BASIC and Tandy/Dragon OS-9 filesystem readers.
Add an About dialog with version, licensing, support, and project information.
Reject weak track-format probe matches before attempting a full decode.
Browse HFE, SCP, and A2R containers through temporary decoded images.
Offer every installed filesystem reader through the image chooser.
Improve probing and geometry discovery for non-80-cylinder formats.
Add HxC HFE v1 and v3 inspection and direct track writing.
Add HFE output for captures, conversions, and blank images.
Preserve initialized filesystems when creating blank HFE media.
